items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...maybe, Osie Johnson or something. [INTERVIEWEE] See, wait a minute… Didn't we do a show album...

ctx.x: Sid Bulkin, drummer, would be on some dates. Then on the other dates it’s always Wendell and Clark or, maybe, Osie Johnson or something.
See, wait a minute… Didn't we do a show album, like a show tune from a Broadway show? Do you have that?
